audit.kind: automated operator audit; not independent human review
audit.access: Parent operator directly inspected public TMDB records in the actual user browser; earlier webfetch was robots-blocked. This implementation records the parent-supplied observations, not a new browser inspection.
audit.separation: Parent auditor is separate from resolver implementation authors. Independent GPT evidence-adequacy review is pending.
audit.basis: Operator judgment from title, creator and work context, comparing visible TMDB facts with frozen primary observations dated 2026-10-29; not Wikidata crosswalk agreement alone.
audit.limitations: Four purposive cases; automated attestation is not calibrated accuracy or population precision. Retrieval remains the existing Wikidata lead search, not TMDB full-catalog search. At Land stays unknown with incomplete retrieval. No resolver tuning, 99% target validation, issue closure or Gate A acceptance.
audit.retention: Minimal factual comparisons and URLs only; no provider pages, images, prose copies or catalog dumps.

evidence.tmdb_locator: Movie title/year header, runtime, creator credits
evidence.comparison: Title and director identify the short work. TMDB 1962 / 29m differs from frozen Criterion 1963 / 27m; neither is normalized.
